_source: 2026-10-31 (V-094 follow-up, BUG-603; shared with BUG-606). What part of a thesis a chapter or heading is, from its title. Roles are tried in order and the first match wins: 'Chapter 3 Methodology Introduction' is methodology and 'Chapter 1 Introduction Background and Rationale' is introduction. Grounded in the chapter titles of the six local theses (LensMatch, AugmentedRL, Destamp, Bimby, MIT, KSA) and the conventional capstone outline. Extend by adding patterns, not code.

agreement._comment: Internal agreement (F4) compares a thesis's own objectives with its own results. A candidate result is set aside when its chapter or nearest heading has one of the results roles; an objective when its chapter has one of the objectives roles. Chapters numbered in objectives_always_kept_chapters keep their objectives whatever their title says: 'Chapter 1 The Problem and Its Background' reads as literature by its words (BUG-625, BUG-650).
